app/actions/issues.ts.behavior: Workspace task commands authorize the current actor and use PostgreSQL to create a task once or recover its dispatch receipt.

app/api/drive/volumes/[volumeId]/blobs/r.behavior: Upload bytes under the authenticated owner and record admission for the selected workspace before a manifest may reference them.

app/api/drive/volumes/[volumeId]/entries.behavior: Commit a bounded set of file changes against the expected head digest. Stale writes and references to blobs outside the selected workspace fail.

app/api/drive/volumes/[volumeId]/files/r.behavior: Read bytes from the selected head or immutable version after workspace and owner authorization, and return them as an attachment.

app/api/drive/volumes/[volumeId]/restore.behavior: Restore an authorized prior version through a new manifest commit, retaining its history.

app/api/drive/volumes/[volumeId]/route.t.behavior: Read the head of an authorized private volume in the requested workspace.

app/api/drive/volumes/[volumeId]/version.behavior: Read one immutable version belonging to the authorized volume.
List the versions of the authorized volume using the installation database.

app/api/drive/volumes/route.ts.behavior: List and create the current owner's private volumes within an authorized workspace.

app/api/internal/github/workflow-result/.behavior: Community installations return 404 before loading GitHub App configuration. The hosted receiver verifies its signed, bounded delivery before recording the result.

app/api/mobile/open/route.ts.behavior: Confirm the signed-in native account on its issuing origin. Self-hosted Task destinations use the configured official client, an expiring single-use record in the existing auth database, and a fresh Task access check.

app/api/organizations/[organizationId]/a.behavior: Require a fresh same-origin human session before renaming one visible organization-bound service credential.
List a page of key metadata for attached team Workspaces the signed-in Organization administrator also administers.

app/api/service-identity/projects/[proje.behavior: Read one live, explicitly granted Project and return its permitted repository and branch metadata without exposing local filesystem aliases.

app/api/service-identity/projects/route..behavior: List live Projects explicitly granted to the service identity under its current organization policy and Project access rules.

app/api/tasks/[taskId]/attachments/route.behavior: List, upload, download and delete task files under the task ACL using the installation database and configured attachment storage.

app/api/workspaces/[workspaceId]/service.behavior: Let a current Workspace administrator inspect or revoke the credential and issue its replacement from a same-origin browser session.
Workspace administrators can read and change explicit Project grants only on Projects they can manage.
Workspace administrators can read, rename, disable or restore a service identity with revision checks.
Workspace administrators can list service identities and create them idempotently in their current Workspace.

apps/api/runtime/http-policy.mjs.behavior: Preserve machine routes, request authority and response headers while selecting an HTML page only for document navigation.

apps/api/scripts/dedupe-functions.mjs.behavior: The Vercel packaging step deduplicates byte-identical function trees only when deployment configuration and resolved dependencies agree. Compose uses the Node server target.

apps/api/scripts/finalize-build.mjs.behavior: Package the Node server and verified runtime resources for self-hosted operation. Official builds additionally record deployment and UI source identity.

apps/eve/agent/agent.ts.behavior: The official Eve host opts into its private Cloudflare World explicitly. Leaving the selector unset preserves the normal workflow selection.

drizzle/20261109143100_coding_review_ses.behavior: Create the PostgreSQL human-review lease table, pending revocations and source-change triggers in the installation database.

drizzle/20261109143101_coding_review_tas.behavior: Fence a review when its Task changes workspace or loses its original stored ownership.

drizzle/20261109143102_coding_review_tas.behavior: Invalidate existing leases for an actual replacement Task run after the Factory binding transaction finishes.

drizzle/20261112030502_task_attachments..behavior: Create PostgreSQL task attachment metadata and enqueue storage retirement on delete, including task cascades.

drizzle/20261112030504_freeze_schedule_r.behavior: The PostgreSQL migration retains distinct schedule request identities when their original bot or workspace is removed.

drizzle/20261112030505_task_creation_rec.behavior: Persist idempotent task creation receipts in PostgreSQL so a retry recovers the original task.

drizzle/20261112030506_drive_blob_worksp.behavior: Record PostgreSQL blob admissions by owner, digest and workspace to prevent cross-tenant reuse by digest alone.

drizzle/20261112030507_scope_personal_dr.behavior: Keep personal volume names unique within their workspace while allowing the same owner to use a name in a different workspace.

drizzle/20261112030508_workspace_service.behavior: Store service identities and idempotent creation receipts in the configured Workspace PostgreSQL database.

drizzle/20261112030509_service_identity_.behavior: Store the unique credential digest and optional expiry in the configured Workspace PostgreSQL database.

drizzle/20261112030510_service_key_organ.behavior: Bind explicitly organization-scoped service keys to their current Workspace attachment and invalidate the matching credential when the attachment is removed.

drizzle/20261112032026_organization_serv.behavior: Give each existing and future organization-bound service key an independent public ID and a nullable name in the Workspace database.

lib/abuse/workers-ai.ts.behavior: Only an explicitly selected managed Workers AI model uses the Cloudflare account and token and the model route refuses missing configuration before provider I/O.

lib/activity-actor-view.ts.behavior: Present local history with stable user, agent and system identities, including deleted actors.

lib/artifacts/storage.ts.behavior: Community installations retain file bytes in PostgreSQL when no object store is configured; an operator may use an S3-compatible bucket.

lib/audit/events.ts.behavior: Validate audit events locally. Forwarded location metadata is read only from a recognized deployment ingress.

lib/board-filters.ts.behavior: Resolve saved board project names to the installation's visible project IDs and retain UUID filters across renames.

lib/cloud-computer/sponsored-lifecycle.t.behavior: Only a sponsored task with an authorized grant starts its Cloudflare machine. The handoff requires a configured HTTPS worker artifact origin and ordinary self-hosted tasks do not provision this service.

lib/cloud-computer/sponsored-task.ts.behavior: A sponsored machine requires the workspace allowlist and a private bridge token. Unconfigured workspaces cannot acquire the machine grant.

lib/cloud-computer/thread-machines.ts.behavior: Question recovery locks the current PostgreSQL task, owner, run and operation before reusing a retained machine. Self-hosted recovery uses its existing database and configured execution provider.

lib/coding-workspace/preview/runtime.ts.behavior: The configured application origin issues a one-use URL only after the existing owner-provided E2B guest acknowledges the scoped preview; an unavailable guest stays unavailable.

lib/coding-workspace/review-authority.ts.behavior: Read the authenticated installation workspace, current Task, native run and checkout from PostgreSQL, and reject a changed owner or credential.

lib/coding-workspace/review-machine.ts.behavior: An active lease can reconnect to its existing E2B sandbox using that owner’s stored provider key and optional HTTPS proxy; no device credential is reissued.

lib/coding-workspace/review-sessions.ts.behavior: Persist and fence terminal and preview leases in PostgreSQL. Preserve pending remote closes for the existing recovery timer.

lib/coding-workspace/terminal/runtime.ts.behavior: Use the installation auth secret to derive an instance-specific terminal key. The owner’s E2B credential permits the same guest to open or close the signed gateway.

lib/coding-workspace/terminal/test-fixtu.behavior: Supplies disposable locally generated wire identities to the signed terminal contract tests.

lib/coding-workspace/terminal/wire.ts.behavior: Bind a short-lived terminal action to its local installation key, current boot, lease and body digest.

lib/coordinator/ci-suite-transport.ts.behavior: Only a committed CI suite notification bound to the finished run can bypass paid semantic triage. The transport grants no GitHub authority.

lib/coordinator/decision-provider.ts.behavior: The native decision route requires an explicit billing profile, matching model and operator key. Unconfigured or disallowed routes cannot reserve or send a provider request.

lib/coordinator/decision.ts.behavior: The Coordinator allows an operator-selected decision endpoint and model. Requests use the existing credential and budget policy for that route.

lib/db/direct-session.ts.behavior: Dedicated connections preserve session locks and use the external installation's direct URL or its bundled PostgreSQL connection.

lib/db/request-scope.ts.behavior: Background work uses the selected installation database and starts its own transaction instead of reusing a request lease.

lib/db/transaction-boundary.ts.behavior: Independent background work receives a separate transaction boundary, including for previously open project and workspace leases.

lib/default-model-config.ts.behavior: Community installations may configure their own complete model endpoint, key and model ID. An incomplete private route is unavailable and optional hosted provider configurations are evaluated separately.

lib/deployment-stage.mjs.behavior: The application stage is optional on local Compose. Explicit production, preview or development stages take precedence over a provider's stage and invalid values fail validation.

lib/device-removal.ts.behavior: Toggle scheduling only for an existing local device owned by the requesting user; return an error if no device changed.

lib/drive/client.ts.behavior: Use the installed same-origin Drive API, scope caches by workspace and account, and upload bytes before publishing the manifest.

lib/drive/server.ts.behavior: Authorize workspace-scoped Drive requests and update versioned manifests in PostgreSQL. File bytes use the installation's existing artifact storage configuration, with inline database storage when no bucket is configured.

lib/enterprise/live-store.ts.behavior: Hold the shared organization policy lock while admitting a service credential.

lib/eve/cloudflare-task-bridge.ts.behavior: The trusted host authenticates each fixed internal task operation, including human review. Community installations without the optional bridge cannot allocate a sponsored task.

lib/eve/cloudflare-task-connection.ts.behavior: The Cloudflare sandbox adapter requires an injected workspace binding and a scoped grant. Ordinary Compose installations do not supply the private binding.

lib/eve/product-rpc.ts.behavior: Self-hosted Eve calls the configured application origin or local server with its signed scope. The private product capability is sent only to the paired Cloudflare service and that deployment refuses to call without it.

lib/eve/session-control-delivery.mjs.behavior: Propagate only a verified native cancel or end request to its own session wake, across asynchronous calls from the official Eve channel.

lib/factory/evidence-folder-index.ts.behavior: Counts visible Factory evidence inside the existing PostgreSQL snapshot, scoped to the owner, workspace and visible Factory IDs.

lib/github/ci-suite-event.ts.behavior: A configured GitHub App projects verified completed check suites into bounded notifications and validates the associated pull-request head.

lib/github/ci-suite-wake.ts.behavior: For a configured GitHub App, use the installation PostgreSQL publication and run records to enqueue a Coordinator wake only for an ended run on the same repository and pull-request head.

lib/github/comment-mention.ts.behavior: Recognizes mentions on GitHub pull requests and returns delivery identities without retaining comment text. The caller may supply its configured GitHub App slug.

lib/github/workflow-result-store.ts.behavior: Only the authenticated hosted CI receipt route writes these PostgreSQL records. Repeated or stale attempts cannot overwrite the latest authorized result.

lib/github/workflow-result.ts.behavior: Community installations return HTTP 404 for the internal CI receipt route. Hosted receipts require a valid domain-separated HMAC, a fresh timestamp and a bounded payload.

lib/governance/http.ts.behavior: Governance mutations recheck the Workspace-scoped session and validate request origin and JSON before applying a change.

lib/governance/organization-api-keys.ts.behavior: Read only current, explicitly bound service keys visible under both admin roles and rename by the ID of a single issuance.

lib/governance/service-credentials.ts.behavior: Issue, rotate or revoke dedicated credentials and authorize Project lists and details using the live Workspace identity, organization policy and recursive Project ACL.

lib/governance/service-identities.ts.behavior: Manage the Workspace service identity registry under a current administrator membership lease. Disabling an identity clears its credential and records the change in the Workspace audit.

lib/governance/service-identity-client.t.behavior: Use the selected server and same-origin session to manage Workspace service identities, Project grants and dedicated credentials.

lib/governance/service-project-access.ts.behavior: Replace explicit grants only with Project management authority and list only active Projects the administrator may both read and share.

lib/hooks/use-task-continuation.ts.behavior: Paged task lists fetch the next authorized cursor on demand and discard previous pages when the current view changes.

lib/issue-threads.ts.behavior: Conversation roots and continuations disclose only the status and content allowed for the current workspace reader.

lib/linear-sync/markdown.ts.behavior: Converts Mikka task content to and from Linear Markdown locally and escapes plain text for comments.

lib/linear-sync/run-comment.ts.behavior: Formats localized run comments, derives repeatable comment IDs, and builds task links from the installation origin and base path supplied by the caller.

lib/mobile-task-handoff.ts.behavior: Accept only a validated Task or immutable receipt and an opaque rendezvous on the configured HTTPS server.

lib/mobile-web-target.ts.behavior: Preserve the allowlist for same-server mobile web handoff. The scoped Members destination requires the official page and current team administrator at exchange and confirmation.

lib/platform/public-origin.ts.behavior: Links and daemon commands follow the selected installation's HTTP origin and base path. Unsafe backend addresses and out-of-scope service paths are rejected.

lib/renderer-actions.mjs.behavior: Read the published web action manifest for the selected deployment. When the legacy manifest returns HTTP 404, use the release action contract with the same deployment pin and validate its compiler inventory.

lib/run-app-mcp.ts.behavior: A run can use an installed toolkit only through the authorized account, tool list and scoped run token.

lib/slack/api.ts.behavior: An enabled Slack integration supplies its bot token to post a completion to the bound channel and thread. The client classifies Slack errors and retry timing without exposing the token.

lib/slack/completion-message.ts.behavior: Formats a localized completion from the visible task label and status, escapes Slack mentions, and builds a link using the caller's installation origin and base path.

lib/task-activity-timeline.ts.behavior: Web and native clients use the same chronological task history, discussion and run facts.

lib/task-activity-versions.ts.behavior: The content-authorized reader retrieves recent task history and the original PostgreSQL creation revision.

lib/task-attachments/contract.ts.behavior: Task attachments enforce file size and count limits when the authorized caller uploads to this installation.

lib/task-attachments/store.ts.behavior: Attachment metadata is scoped to the task in PostgreSQL. File bytes use the local database fallback or the configured object store.

lib/task-collection.ts.behavior: The client groups the authorized task presentations and keeps waiting tasks associated with their actual Bot.

lib/task-create-command.ts.behavior: Validate create-only and dispatch requests with the current workspace, task scope and request ID.

lib/task-create-form.ts.behavior: The shared task form preserves its create or dispatch intent and accepts the matching server receipt.

lib/task-create-only.ts.behavior: An authorized create-only request persists a task once in PostgreSQL without starting a run or calling a model.

lib/task-create-scope.ts.behavior: Creation authorizes the selected team or project UUID and preserves that scope on retry.

lib/task-creation-receipt.ts.behavior: PostgreSQL records the task returned for an idempotent create request and returns its original identity on retry.

lib/task-discussion.ts.behavior: A typed discussion carries the author, creation time, resolution state and messages into the shared activity view.

lib/task-dispatch-lock.ts.behavior: An independent PostgreSQL pool takes a transaction-scoped advisory lock for each task, leaving application connections available for admission.

lib/task-dispatch-receipt.ts.behavior: An authorized caller can recover its accepted dispatch receipt with the original task and destination.

lib/task-dispatches.ts.behavior: Read actual Task dispatches from PostgreSQL once per batch, restricted to the current workspace and the signed-in reader's own Bots.

lib/task-factory-events.ts.behavior: Only visible Factory events and their immutable evidence revisions appear on a task.

lib/task-list-page.ts.behavior: Cursor pages preserve database precision and traverse each authorized task exactly once.

lib/task-presentation-batch.ts.behavior: Native and Web readers request at most 200 distinct tasks per page and reject a workspace mismatch.

lib/task-project-options.ts.behavior: Project choices preserve their authorized record IDs, including when names are duplicated or a project is renamed.

lib/task-resource-registration.ts.behavior: Task resource registration persists its workspace and privacy defaults under the authorized PostgreSQL transaction.

lib/task-thread-run.ts.behavior: Select the Task run using the installation’s PostgreSQL relations, excluding group chat and late-bound Factory checker runs.

lib/task-workspace.ts.behavior: Workspace membership is checked against the current transaction boundary before granting task access.

lib/ui-overlay.mjs.behavior: Self-hosted installations build the server and its authentication and status pages from public source. Official Web and Desktop releases require a verified private checkout and its required slot exports.

lib/web-connection/mobile-task-location..behavior: Keep the entity out of the physical official URL and invalidate the in-memory route when the active server or account changes.

lib/workers-ai-config.ts.behavior: A hosted Cloudflare container authorizes its fixed account with an instance-scoped service binding. Operators can also configure a model-specific REST token. Community installations can use their own configured model.

lib/workspace-db.ts.behavior: Workspace reads and transactions use the configured PostgreSQL connection with scoped leases and savepoint rollback.

services/credential-broker/server.mjs.behavior: The standalone broker is outside the standard Compose stack. When deployed separately its listen port is configurable and credential handlers enforce caller identity.

app/api/integrations/slack/callback/rout.behavior: Accept one browser-bound Slack OAuth code and encrypt the bot grant for the currently authorized workspace.

app/api/integrations/slack/connect/route.behavior: Consume an authenticated member’s one-time handoff before opening the official Slack consent URL.

app/api/integrations/slack/route.ts.behavior: Show or update only an active member’s Slack installation and channel preferences. Missing platform configuration disables installation.

app/api/internal/eve/slack-credential/ro.behavior: Require the scoped Eve principal, recipient proof, current workspace membership, and current link generation to obtain the native bot credential.

apps/eve/agent/hooks/slack-installation..behavior: Store non-secret, verified Slack link coordinates in the official Eve session for rendering a resumed turn.

drizzle/20261112030512_slack_workspace_i.behavior: Persist single-use browser state, encrypted Workspace installations, and member-specific channel preferences in the existing application PostgreSQL database.

lib/slack/channel-grant.ts.behavior: Get an uncached, member-bound native Slack credential from the configured product host for this Eve session.

lib/slack/channel-scope.ts.behavior: Carry only verified coordinates within Eve’s signed request and durable session; absent Slack identity cannot resolve credentials.

lib/slack/grant-proof.ts.behavior: Bind the dedicated Slack grant proof to the timed Eve authorization, team, sender, installation and active member link.

lib/slack/install-provider.ts.behavior: Use Slack OAuth, bot identity validation, member-visible conversation metadata and official revocation APIs for an operator-configured Slack app.

lib/slack/installation-store.ts.behavior: Encrypt grants under the workspace secret key, lock refreshes, verify the active member link and disable local use before remote uninstall.

lib/slack/installed-routing.ts.behavior: Read coordinates only from the platform-signed Slack app/team envelope, bound sender and validated revocation events.

lib/slack/eve-channel.ts.behavior: The official Eve Slack channel accepts signed events only from a verified Slack member with active workspace access and a current OAuth link.

lib/coding-workspace/cloudflare-review.t.behavior: A separately admitted sponsored checkout builds a bounded human lease. Local and owner-provided E2B review keep their existing transport.
